title: Hours of Power: D&C 4 and the Counter-Cultural Law of Diligence
summary: Following a Sunday sacrament visit to the Bocaue area, President Hughes relays new area presidency clothing and safety protocols for public shopping. He requests strict privacy setup for the upcoming virtual zone interviews and provides an update on three stranded MTC sisters. Deconstructing Doctrine and Covenants 4, he details how its listed Christlike attributes protect companion harmony during apartment confinement, specifically elevating 'diligence' as an antidote to modern laziness and a validation of personal self-respect. Finally, noting he signed 30 premature release certificates, he challenges the remaining missionaries to transform their confinement into an hour-by-hour pursuit of personal and ministerial power.
